[You can access the private project (code, figures, explanations…) via this link](https://bd-casp-private.cmaslard.xyz/). Access is restricted (Cloudflare Access). Use your authorized email to receive a one-time login code. If you don’t receive a code within \~60 seconds, your email is likely not allow-listed; please contact me.

Bd CASP1 is a private analysis workspace for a single-nucleus transcriptomics project in *Brachypodium distachyon*. Experimental details, intermediate results, and biological interpretations are intentionally omitted from this public page while the work remains unpublished.
